management_remarks: In Q2 FY26, ICICI Bank recorded robust operating profit expansion supported by 15.2% domestic advances growth and stable Net Interest Margin of 4.31%. Our wealth and private banking franchise achieved record assets under management, while consolidated subsidiaries ICICI Prudential AMC and ICICI Lombard delivered market-leading profitability. Credit costs remained benign at 38 basis points as corporate and mortgage asset quality stayed exceptionally clean.
analyst_qa: On credit cost normalization, while current slippages are low, historical seasoning implies provision expenses could edge up from cyclical troughs under challenging macro conditions. Competition for granular retail deposits remains intense, and credit growth in unsecured segments is moderating under our calibrated risk guardrails. Fee income momentum is subject to regulatory adjustments on payment charges and uncertain capital market volatility.
